disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean ± SD lead, cadmium, zinc, nickel and copper in five leafy vegetables by time of purchase.

controls.outcome: Pooled lead 0.62 -> 1.65 mg/kg (p=0.003), zinc 0.12 -> 0.25, copper 0.10 -> 0.20 mg/kg (Table 2); per-vegetable lead higher in every evening sample (Table 1)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: FAO/WHO standards as printed under Table 1
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Pb 0.3, Cd 0.2, Zn 0.12, Ni 0.7, Cu 0.2 mg/kg (text also cites Zn 99.4 mg/kg)

unresolved: Table 2 pooled cadmium (morning 0.51, afternoon 0.16) and nickel (morning 0.51, afternoon 0.09) means conflict with Table 1, where no morning cadmium exceeds 0.13 and no nickel exceeds 0.15 mg/kg; Table 2 not used as findings.
Per-market values exist only in Figures 1-5; not read.
Number of samples per vegetable and collection dates not stated.
Ugwu Latin name printed as Telfaria occidentalis in the abstract and Cucurbita maxima in the methods.
